title: Field Guide quiz questions
description: content/trivia/<group>.json: one group's questions for the Field Guide quiz (docs/trivia.md §3). Mirrors TriviaBankFile in packages/shared/src/types/trivia.ts; where the two disagree, the TypeScript type wins. tools/content/trivia-bank.mjs checks what the schema cannot see: ids unique across every file, entry, also and image naming Field Guide pages, every other page's title the words use listed in also, the word limits, a link "entry" whose answer is not the page's own name, and a picture for every question.

option.description: An option as the phone shows it: words, under 10 of them, no em dashes.

id.description: Unique across every bank file: <entry id>.<slug>.

entry.description: The Field Guide page it is about: a key of content/field-guide.json entries.

wrong.description: Five or six wrong options; three are drawn each time it is asked (§4.2).

also.description: Every other Field Guide page the question or any option names (§3.3); the question is asked only once the household has found them all.

link.description: entry: a wrong answer's link opens the page. shelf: it opens the page's tab, because the answer is the page's own name (§4.3).

image.description: Ask it over another page's painting (§3.5): the entry or one of also.
